scripts.expo:build:web: cd apps/expo && npx expo export -p web
scripts.verify: npm run verify:worker && npm run verify:admin && npm run verify:expo
scripts.verify:worker: cd apps/worker && npm run typecheck && npm test && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir=/tmp/worker-build
scripts.verify:admin: cd apps/admin-panel && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.verify:expo: cd apps/expo && npm run typecheck && npm run check:icons && npm test
